text: New Era Cap, LLC is a Buffalo-based headwear company described as family-owned, led by fourth-generation CEO Christopher H. Koch. Private-equity firm ACON Investments calls New Era a portfolio company: it invested in January 2021 as New Era's first institutional equity capital and said in June 2024 it would maintain a significant stake in the combined company acquiring '47.
short: New Era Cap is family-owned (Koch family) with a significant ACON Investments stake.

source.name: ACON Investments: 'ACON Portfolio Investment, New Era, to Acquire '47, Creating Premier Global Sport and Lifestyle Company'
source.quote: New Era is a portfolio company of ACON, a Washington, D.C.-based private equity firm.
